description.value: Persephone Brewing is a certified B Corp farm brewery on BC's Sunshine Coast, running a working five-acre farm — barley fields, apple orchards, market gardens, and laying hens — alongside its craft brewing operation. The on-site tasting room and kitchen serve multiple award-winning beers, including Canadian Brewing Award winners, made with farm-grown and locally sourced ingredients. Cyclists passing through Gibsons will find a genuinely distinctive farm-to-barrel stop with outdoor picnic areas and a community-rooted ethos.
